With `usePlural`, it tries the input without its trailing `s` first, then the full input. It still throws `Model "<model>" not found in schema` when nothing resolves.
- **Tests:** I added `packages/core/src/db/adapter/get-default-model-name.test.ts`. It covers the expected results you listed, including the collision configuration and the `references.model` check.

I didn't add an `@see` issue link to the tests because no issue number was given. I haven't committed anything.
